svg.title: SnapVault search eval
svg.desc: Dumbbell chart of the SnapVault search eval at k=10, 100 questions over 50 documents. Each pair runs from the keyword matcher to static embeddings. semantic questions (n=40): recall 0.701 to 0.901, MRR 0.593 to 0.802. hard questions (n=20): recall 1.000 to 1.000, MRR 0.849 to 0.900. lexical questions (n=40): recall 1.000 to 1.000, MRR 0.942 to 0.975. Recall is the share of the answer passage the retrieved chunks cover. MRR is the reciprocal rank of the right file.
